Definition: neuter of G4413 as adverb (with or without G3588); firstly (in time, place, order, or importance):--before, at the beginning, chiefly (at, at the) first (of all).
BiblicalUsage: Proton, as an adverb, means first, firstly, before all. It appears once as its own word, in Paul's charge about widows: let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents, for that is good and acceptable before God.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that piety begins at home: the first duty of the faithful is not the church or the world, but their own parents.
